manual_review: Choice prompts are self-contained, with one answer and a grounded explanation for every distractor.
Inspect-and-judge excerpts include trap items and distinguish authored fixture evidence from native execution.
Expected code results were derived by executing the submitted solutions, never entered from memory.
The strict gate checks taught-before-tested, runtime results, starter failure and anti-hard-coding.

limitations: Settings uses genuine Pydantic v1 BaseSettings with a supplied dotenv-source adapter because pydantic-settings and python-dotenv are unavailable; this does not verify SettingsConfigDict or actual dotenv parsing.

Serving and outbound timeout practices are authored inspect-and-judge fixtures, not native process/network execution.
